Author: Ostinato
Name: Ostinato
Description: Replaces the action the game asks about with the best next action from per-job rule packs compiled from a strict-JSON encyclopedia.
TestingChangelog:
1. White Mage, first entry: game data, job entry, Healing Gauge, the single-target (Glare) and AoE (Holy) combos with seven settings, and Route targets for WHM heals and buffs.
2. Route: new "farthest" target choice (the farthest party member still in range). WHM Rescue uses it.
3. Ground-targeted actions (Asylum, Liturgy of the Bell) default to your hard target, else yourself. Known issue: in this build they only open the targeting circle; a fix is coming.

Minor: the plugin description no longer names jobs; the WHM job button appears on every screen; WHM checks added to the in-game checklist.
